name: KitchenPrepProductionPlanner
tagline: Prep the right amount, on time – par-based prep lists scaled to tonight's covers, with a station board, cook workload and check & label workflow in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete prep production app for hotel, restaurant and banquet kitchens: par levels scale to the forecast covers of each service with a safety buffer, on-hand counts turn into prep quantities rounded to whole batches, minutes per batch give the workload, start-by and needed-by times, and the app flags late, start-now, critical-stock and not-counted lines. Cooks work from a drag-and-drop station board (To prep → In progress → Prepared → Checked), record prepared quantities and probe temperatures, and chefs check, label, assign, re-plan with a forecast what-if and create tomorrow's list in one click. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Par levels scaled to forecast covers per service with a safety buffer
On-hand count mode – type counts straight into the list
Prep quantity = adjusted par − on hand, rounded up to whole batches
Minutes per batch → workload, start-by and needed-by per service
Late, start-now, critical-stock and not-counted alerts
Drag-and-drop station board with keyboard buttons
Prepared quantity with over-prep / short tolerance and reasons
Core-temperature check for cooked items, label confirmation, use-by from the hold time
Cook workload against prep capacity and bulk assign
New prep list for the next day from today's items
Roles: line cook (own lines), sous chef, head chef (re-open, critical skips, delete)
Undo, CSV export, printable prep label
Power Fx outputs and events (SummaryJson, PrepLabelText, NewRecordJson)
